title: AW28 Kids' Forest School
summary: Outdoor winter for children: bottle-green coats, waterproof layers, cord and fleece.
research_period: AW28/29 colour previews (October 2026), AW27 fairs (September 2026), SS28 previews

sections.heading: How this forecast was built
sections.body: Long-range projection. AW28 kidswear fairs take place in January 2028. This report projects from the first AW28/29 colour forecasts, the AW27 fairs, kidswear brands' long-term practices and market drivers, and will be updated as evidence arrives.

sections.heading: The story
sections.body: Forecut's AW28 projection puts bottle green with cocoa and oat in its "Deep Forest" story <sup>[1]</sup>; kidswear brands build on durable, organic and merino materials <sup>[2]</sup>.

design_implications: - Safety: no drawstrings or long cords at the hood, neck or waist, in line with EN 14682; test the attachment strength of buttons, snaps and decorations, and keep small detachable parts off baby and toddler pieces.

sources.title: Forecut AW28 colour forecast
sources.note: Long-range Forecut projection carrying the AW27 move away from black and the SS28 return of strong blues and violets
